walkthroughs.body_html:
Birling calls the Titanic "unsinkable, absolutely unsinkable".

The 1945 audience knew it sank. This dramatic irony destroys his credibility before the Inspector even speaks.

His final speech — "We are members of one body" — is Priestley's mouthpiece for socialism.

The biblical echo gives it moral authority.

Sheila changes; her parents don't. She acts as a foil to them.

Priestley uses her to argue that hope lies with the young generation.
